Name: Live Farm Map
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Live Farm Map[/b][/size]

Adds a full-screen map of your farm as it really is right now, with your buildings, crops, animals and everything you've placed.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Your real farm:[/b] the world map shows the same picture of your farm type all game. This map draws the farm as it actually is, shrunk to fit the screen, without night or weather so it's always easy to read.[/*]
[*][b]Live:[/b] while it's open, the map is redrawn every few seconds (you can change how often), so you can watch other players and animals move around in multiplayer.[/*]
[*][b]People icons:[/b] like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] does on the world map, every player on the farm gets a small portrait and every villager a head icon, so you can spot them at a glance. They move smoothly between redraws, and pointing at one shows their name. Animals don't get icons.[/*]
[*][b]Easy to open:[/b] click the farm on the world map (or select it with a controller), click the [b]Farm[/b] button in the world map's top-left corner, or press [font=Courier New]Left Shift + M[/font] from anywhere. The farm map has a [b]World[/b] button in the same corner to switch back. Close it with Esc, the map key, right-click or the close button.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Settings are in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] (created the first time you launch the game with the mod), and can be changed in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[list]
[*][b]Enabled:[/b] whether the farm map can be opened.[/*]
[*][b]Open key:[/b] the keys which open the farm map, from the world or the world map. Default [font=Courier New]Left Shift + M[/font].[/*]
[*][b]Refresh every (seconds):[/b] how often the map is redrawn while it's open, from 1 to 10. Default 5.[/*]
[*][b]Show people:[/b] whether to show icons for the players and villagers on the farm.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], to change settings in-game[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installing[/b][/size]
Unzip it into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.

[size=4][b]For mod authors[/b][/size]
Other mods can read the farm's buildings and mini-obelisks, open the farm map and draw on it through Live Farm Map's API. See the mod's README on GitHub for how to use it.

[size=4][b]Source code, bugs and suggestions[/b][/size]
The source code is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]
Please report bugs and suggestions as [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods/issues]GitHub issues[/url] rather than on the Bugs or Posts tabs here.
